overview_description.description:
Vuori offers a collection of apparel brand for men and women. It sells shorts, pants, tops, graphic T-shirts, gift cards, hats, and clothing for yoga instructors, surfers, cross-fit instructors, personal trainers, and individuals. 

Vuori offers its products through dealers in San Diego, Del Mar, and Solana Beach in California. Joseph Kudla founded Vuori on January 1, 2014, with its headquarters in Encinitas in California.
